title: wholesome briny light croatian walnuts biscotti
description: a classic croatian biscotti recipe featuring the rich flavors of walnuts and the salty notes of cure, perfect for a light breakfast or snack.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality unbleached flour for best results

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use a flaky sea salt for added texture

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality muscovado sugar for best flavor

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: melted but still cool to the touch

ingredients.name: cure
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality flaky sea salt cure, such as maldon or fleur de sel

ingredients.name: granulated sugar
ingredients.notes: used as a topping after baking

instructions: line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
whisk together the flour, baking soda, and salt in a medium bowl.
in a large bowl, whisk together the brown sugar, melted butter, eggs, and oregano.
add the walnuts and mix until they are evenly distributed.
add the flour mixture and mix until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
transfer the dough to the prepared baking sheet and shape it into a log about 12 inches long.
place the log in the oven and bake for 30 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden.
remove the log from the oven and let it cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes.
transfer the log to a cutting board and slice it into 1/2-inch thick rounds.
place the rounds on the baking sheet and bake for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden.
remove the biscotti from the oven and let them cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes.
while the biscotti are cooling, mix together the granulated sugar and cure in a small bowl.
dip the tops of the biscotti into the sugar mixture, coating them evenly.
place the biscotti on a wire rack to cool completely.
